    flood = padded.copy()
    cv2.floodFill(flood, None, (0, 0), 1)
    holes = flood == 0

            [8.0, 72.0, 67.0],
            [16.0, 105.0, 75.0],
            [24.0, 110.0, 77.0],
            [32.0, 115.0, 79.0],
            [40.0, 120.0, 82.0],
            [48.0, 125.0, 84.0],
            [56.0, 131.0, 85.0],
            [64.0, 137.0, 87.0],
            [72.0, 142.0, 90.0],
            [80.0, 147.0, 91.0],
            [88.0, 153.0, 93.0],
            [95.0, 158.0, 94.0],
        ],
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    x = np.interp(frame_index, knots[:, 0], knots[:, 1])
    y = np.interp(frame_index, knots[:, 0], knots[:, 2])
